Question 12
?

Consider the straight line that passes through P(1,0,0) and is parallel to v=⟨1,1,1⟩. Find all the possible points R on that line such that RP=33.

a
R1(4,−3,−3) and R2(2,3,3)
b
R1(4,3,3) and R2(−2,−3,−3)
c
R1(4,3,3) and R2(2,3,3)
d
R1(3,4,4) and R2(3,−2,−2)
e
R1(4,2,2) and R2(−3,−2,−2)
